description: Header file defining the RustTool class, which manages Rust build tools within a build system, including configuration, validation, and output patterns.

classes.name: RustTool
classes.description: Represents a Rust build tool configuration within the build system, providing methods for initialization, validation, and output pattern management.

methods.name: RustTool
methods.description: Constructor for RustTool, initializes with a name.

methods.name: InitTool
methods.description: Initializes the tool with scope, toolchain, and error handling.

methods.name: SetComplete
methods.description: Marks the tool configuration as complete.

methods.name: MayLink
methods.description: Indicates if the tool may perform linking.

methods.name: AsRust
methods.description: Returns this object as a RustTool pointer.

methods.name: GetSysroot
methods.description: Returns the system root path for Rust.

methods.name: set_dynamic_link_switch
methods.description: Sets the dynamic link switch string.

methods.name: link_output
methods.description: Returns the link output substitution pattern.

methods.name: set_link_output
methods.description: Sets the link output substitution pattern.

methods.name: depend_output
methods.description: Returns the depend output substitution pattern.

methods.name: set_depend_output
methods.description: Sets the depend output substitution pattern.

methods.name: ValidateLinkAndDependOutput
methods.description: Validates link or depend output patterns.
